{
  "name": "minibob-cicd-demo",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "MiniBob CI/CD integration demo: deterministic activities + learning-based fixes + upkeep automation",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "test": "bun test",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint src/ tests/",
    "build": "bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist",
    "ci": "bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test",

    "minibob": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest",

    "check:types": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/deterministic/run-typecheck.json",
    "check:lint": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/deterministic/run-lint.json",
    "check:tests": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/deterministic/run-test-suite.json",

    "fix:types": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/learning/fix-type-error.json",
    "fix:lint": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/learning/fix-lint-error.json",
    "fix:tests": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/learning/fix-test-failure.json",

    "upkeep:readme": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/upkeep/sync-readme.json",
    "upkeep:changelog": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/upkeep/sync-changelog.json",

    "goal": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --single",

    "dev:introduce-bug": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/development/introduce-change.json --var changeType=random",
    "dev:add-feature": "bunx @metabob/minibob@latest --template activities/development/introduce-change.json --var changeType=feature"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@metabob/minibob": "^0.3.4"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/bun": "latest",
    "typescript": "^5.4.0",
    "eslint": "^9.0.0",
    "@eslint/js": "^9.0.0",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.0.0"
  }
}
